mode,label,expected=sys.argv[1:4]
assert mode in {'catalog','plan','actual'} and label.startswith('a1-') and '/' not in label

assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==expected and not git('status','--porcelain')
out=Path('/tmp/a1-implementation-tools')/label;assert not out.exists();out.mkdir(parents=True)

def binaries():
 return [dict(path=p,sha256=hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=(root/p).stat().st_size) for p in paths if (root/p).is_file()]

if mode=='catalog':
 assert len(sys.argv)==4;args+=['-ValidateCatalog']

 manifest=Path(sys.argv[4]);prep=json.loads(manifest.read_text());assert prep['mode']=='catalog' and prep['nativeExit']==0 and prep['binaryAfter']==before and len(before)==4
 compiled=prep['sourceHead'];delta=git('diff','--name-only',compiled,expected).decode().splitlines();assert all(p.startswith('specs/1536-complete-wound-materialization/') for p in delta)
 if mode=='plan':
  assert len(sys.argv)==5;args+=['-SelectionFile','tests/selection.json','-PlanOnly','-NoBuild']
 else:
  category=sys.argv[5];assert len(sys.argv)==6 and category in {'fr063-training-level-policy-boundary','fr063-training-level-policy','fr063-training-level-ordinary','fr063-joint-late-completion'}
  args+=['-Category',category,'-NoBuild']
result_root=root/'TestResults/test-categories';old=set(result_root.iterdir()) if result_root.exists() else set()
prefixes=['boe-training-level-a1-*','boe-joint-automatic-control-*','boe-gameengine-turnlifecycle-*']
def roots():return sorted(str(p) for pattern in prefixes for p in Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).glob(pattern))
prefix_before=roots();start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();clock=time.monotonic()
print('LOCAL_A1_START',mode,expected,'log',out/'stdout.log',flush=True)
with (out/'stdout.log').open('wb') as stream:
 done=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
elapsed=time.monotonic()-clock;new=sorted(str(p) for p in set(result_root.iterdir())-old) if result_root.exists() else []
after=binaries();head_after=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip();status=git('status','--porcelain').decode()
j=dict(mode=mode,label=label,argv=args,cwd=str(root),sourceHead=expected,startedUtc=start,finishedUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),wallSeconds=elapsed,nativeExit=done.returncode,stdoutPath=str(out/'stdout.log'),stdoutSha256=hashlib.sha256((out/'stdout.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),resultDirectories=new,binaryBefore=before,binaryAfter=after,headAfter=head_after,statusAfter=status,ownedPrefixesBefore=prefix_before,ownedPrefixesAfter=roots(),helperText=Path(__file__).read_text(),runtimeScope='local fresh preparation ZERO execution' if mode!='actual' else 'ONE explicitly selected bounded category; no CI/Windows/worker',authority='Actual invocation requires separately accepted concrete SOURCE/release; this helper is not a release.')
(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2)+'\n')
print('LOCAL_A1_EXIT',done.returncode,'wall',round(elapsed,3),'results',new,'record',out/'record.json',flush=True)
assert head_after==expected and not status
if mode!='catalog':assert before==after
sys.exit(done.returncode)
